verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.oysterhr.com (HTTP 200, titled "Oyster Public API Documentation"). Its contents index API endpoints such as engagements, benefits, bonuses and allowances, plus guides like the reseller and integration-listing instructions. Doc pages are also served as .md files, which suits agent consumption. Missing for 10: evidence of an llms-full.txt or explicit agent-usage guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully using these docs.
